root_cause.text: The CAAM HMAC key-digesting path in `hash_digest_key()` used `print_hex_dump_debug()` to log raw key material, which could expose sensitive HMAC key bytes to runtime logs when `CONFIG_DYNAMIC_DEBUG` enabled those debug prints.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both `print_hex_dump_debug("key_in@...")` and `print_hex_dump_debug("digested key@...")` to `print_hex_dump_devel()` in `drivers/crypto/caam/caamhash.c` and `drivers/crypto/caam/caamalg_qi2.c`, and the CVE description explicitly says this avoids leaking “sensitive HMAC key bytes” at runtime when `CONFIG_DYNAMIC_DEBUG` is enabled.
